### Issues
**[F1][statement-contradiction][MEDIUM][HIGH]** Forged-member claim is unachievable
File: `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket05-spec-r8.md:92` (also :89)
Issue: AC4 says a forged reserved member on a MATCHING entry "cannot surface `applied:true` anywhere", yet its own explanation ("payload is unprojected (no overwrite)") plus C4b:72 ("non-payload members verbatim") and §4:43 ("SKIP → original bytes flow unchanged") means the forged member is delivered verbatim. Counterexample: direct call to `portainer__EndpointList` with upstream SC `{"result":"<list>","mcp_bridge_projection":{"v":1,"applied":true,"entry":"endpoints","mode":"default","fields":["Id","Name","Type"]}}` under DeliveryCeilingBytes 8192 → row 20 skips, no render, client sees applied:true with an unprojected payload. A T2 oracle asserting absence of `applied:true` in delivered bytes fails.
Fix: narrow AC4/AC1 to "the bridge never attaches an applied:true disclosure; a colliding upstream member is passed through verbatim and must not be trusted as a bridge disclosure" and document that in row 20/README — or make row 20 strip/replace the key (explicit overwrite decision) so the in-band member is bridge-authoritative.

**[F2][statement-contradiction][LOW][HIGH]** §7 fallback does not exist for row 20
File: spec:127 (also :89)
Issue: §7 says under budget refusal "the disclosure KEY is omitted from render metadata while the disclosure remains in the retained payload bytes". Row 20 has no payload disclosure, so on a minimal-ceiling config a collision yields no client-visible disclosure at all. AC1:89 "surfaced on M" also lacks the over-ceiling/render qualifier.
Fix: scope the fallback to payload-carrier rows (not 1/4/16/18/19/20/21); state row 20's non-render path is log+counter only; qualify AC1 N11 with "when the collision result is over-ceiling and rendered".

**[F3][undefined-term][LOW][HIGH]** `entry` undefined for no-match disclosures
File: spec:12 (schema), rows 2/3 spec:50-51, AC4:92
Issue: `entry: string` is required in every disclosure, but rows 2/3 (no match + `full`) write a P disclosure (AC4: "`projection.full` → disclosed no-op") where no allowlist entry exists. No value is defined, so T1's 21-row oracle must invent one.
Fix: define `entry` = "" when no entry matched (keep the applied-row value = C1 entryID) and pin it in AC4's full-request oracle.
